verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe multiple built-in AI delegation features—assigning issues to Copilot for automated PRs, managing Copilot cloud agent tasks, Copilot code review, and natural-language chat with Copilot for codebase Q&A and PR creation—directly within the mobile app. No community evidence contradicts these specific AI capabilities, though most community feedback predates these features and focuses on general UI issues.
